name: library-management-system
description: Tailwind CSS v4 build for the Library Management System (TailAdmin design system)

scripts.build: npm run build:css && npm run build:js
scripts.build:js: node node_modules/esbuild/bin/esbuild assets/js/app.js --bundle --minify --outfile=assets/js/app.min.js && node node_modules/esbuild/bin/esbuild assets/js/charts.js --bundle --minify --outfile=assets/js/charts.min.js
